_comment: Worked example for reel-compose.py --cards. The numbers are invented, replace them with your own. Times are seconds into a roughly 68 second take, and every card except the endcard needs both 'at' and 'out'. The endcard renders on the --cut variant only. Run `python3 $SKILL/scripts/reel_cards.py --list` for the fields each type accepts, where SKILL is ~/.claude/skills/video-reel-factory.
